name: SalSon Logistics - Dick's Sporting Goods Conklin DC (Dedicated Fleet) - Conklin NY

fieldNotes.locate: Resolved to 1314 Conklin Road, Conklin NY 13748 — the Dick's Sporting Goods Conklin e-commerce distribution center, a large single-tenant DC in the Susquehanna River valley south of Binghamton. SalSon Logistics runs a DEDICATED-FLEET transportation operation out of this DC (SalSon is the carrier/transport partner, not the DC operator). Google geocode returned a ROOFTOP hit at 42.0411656,-75.8098423; the locked center is moved onto the building footprint. The old stub mislabeled this site 'Fishkill NY' — corrected to Conklin, NY.
fieldNotes.facilityNature: A very large modern e-commerce DC building with an extensive trailer drop yard along its NE/east side. The building runs roughly NW-SE; docks face the east into the truck court / drop yard; employee car-parking is at the SE corner with the office.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court / drop yard is enclosed; the truck access road from Conklin Road runs along the building's SE end and into the truck court through a defined entrance pinch-point. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small structure sits at the building's SE corner beside the truck-court entrance pinch-point, but from satellite it reads as attached to the building rather than a standalone median guard booth, and no barrier arm is clearly visible. Classed remoteGs = true (kiosk/gatehouse-window check-in); guardShack flagged uncertain — a manned gatehouse window is plausible at a DC of this scale but could not be confirmed as a separate booth in imagery.
fieldNotes.drop: Massive trailer drop yard along the NE/east side — many hundreds of parked trailers in long rows. dropArea 50+, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: A long continuous dock bank along the building's east face — estimated ~120 doors for an e-commerce DC of this footprint. Overhead estimate — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Single very long dock bank along one face — ship/receive read as one continuous cluster, not physically separate banks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Large truck court with wide aisles and abundant paved width — room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Conklin NY is a small rural town in a wooded river valley; the DC sits among fields, the Susquehanna River, and a parallel rail line, well outside any dense metro fabric — Rural.
fieldNotes.rail: A rail line runs through the valley near the DC but does not spur into the property — railServed = false.
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the DC building plus the east drop yard and the SE car-parking apron: ~668 m N-S x ~414 m E-W ≈ 68 acres. The truckGate box is the SE truck-court entrance off the Conklin Road access road.
